title: Story premise ENT088: The Font Committee
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (creative-work struggles). Hook: Every letter wants the leading role. Takeaway/theme: Hierarchy can give a detail emphasis without decorating everything.
description: A creator wants one readable caption, but each letter insists on using a different decorative costume. After the words become impossible to fit, the creator gives every letter the same simple outfit and lets only the key word wear a small hat, making the joke readable at a glance.
